description.en: An elongate fossil fruit carries a broad circular funnel-shaped persistent calyx.
description.zh: 长形化石果实带宽圆漏斗状宿存萼。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Dillhoffia cachensis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Dillhoffia cachensis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Unlobed flared calyx around a narrow fruit makes a trumpet silhouette unlike Florissantia's five-lobed flower.
distinctness.zh: 窄果周围无裂外张萼形成喇叭轮廓，区别于Florissantia五裂花。

modeling_brief.en: Build a shallow flared disc around a central elongated body; use only major radial ridges.
modeling_brief.zh: 围绕中央长果体建立浅外张盘，仅保留主要放射脊。

uncertainty: Family and whole-plant habit are unresolved; preserved reproductive morphology is the intended concept.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
